scaffold.canvas-theme-editor.notes: Tukuake te theme.css me te theme.js ki te Kaiwhakatika Kaupapa o Canvas (Advanced → CSS / JavaScript) kia wātea ai ngā kara o pantoken ki ia whārangi.
scaffold.canvas-theme-editor.caveats: Ka ārai a Canvas i te HTML i whakapirihia i te taha tūmau — tirohia tonu te ihirangi i whakapirihia mai i te rōpū matapaki RCE i roto i Canvas.
scaffold.canvas-theme-editor.i18n.pageDe: Tuhia ngā tauira whārangi RCE o Canvas kua āta hoahoa ki te pantoken, me tētahi matakitaki ora.
scaffold.canvas-theme-editor.i18n.resize: Whanui / whiti i te kaitaipitopito me te tirohanga
scaffold.canvas-theme-editor.i18n.helpMo: Me pēhea te whakamahi i tēnei whārangi

Tīpakohia he tauira tīmatanga, whakatikahia pēnei i roto i te Kaiwhakatika Ihirangi Rawa o Canvas, katahi ka pāwhiri Copy HTML ka whakapiri te hua ki tētahi whārangi Canvas (hurihia ki te tirohanga kaiwhakatika HTML i te tuatahi). Ka ārai a Canvas i te HTML i whakapirihia i te taha tūmau — kāore tēnei matakitaki e kopa i tērā, nō reira me whakamātau tonu i te hua kua whakapirihia i roto i Canvas.
Whakamahia te Edit theme ki te huri i te kaiwhakarato CDN, te kaupapa, te aratau, me te āta whakatika i ngā kōnae whakauru theme.css/theme.js i mua i te tikiake.
